extension.description:
Watch live channels, live events, replays and shows from your Kayo Sports subscription.
Subscription required. Requires script.module.slyguy (installed automatically from the NERV Repository) and Kodi 20 or newer.
extension.news:
v1.3.0 - Sign in by scanning a QR code (email and password sign in is still available under Login method in the settings) - Choose which Kayo profile to watch as - Resume points are synced with Kayo, so replays and live events resume where you stopped on any device - Keep the start of live events longer than 4 hours (eg. Test cricket) in the rewind window - Request HEVC and Dolby audio where SlyGuy's codec settings allow it - Skip a Kayo CDN that doesn't respond - Clearer messages for geo-blocking, too many streams and licence errors
v1.2.1 - Fix "Widevine license request failed" on devices with a software Widevine CDM (Linux, Windows, macOS)
v1.2.0 - Resume a live event from where you stopped watching, alongside Join Live and From Start
v1.1.0 - Choose Join Live or From Start when playing a live event that has already started
v1.0.0 - Initial release for the DAZN-based Kayo platform
